desc:
🌱 Grandma lost her phone somewhere in the grass!


Start with tiny nail clippers and cut your way through her overgrown yard. Sell your grass, buy better tools, and team up with friends to find Grandma's phone before it's gone forever!

✂️ Cut grass and fill your bag
💰 Sell your grass for cash
🛠️ Unlock 20 tools, from nail clippers to futuristic mowers
📱 Find Grandma's phone and save the day
👥 Play solo or with up to 4 friends
🎡 Spin the prize wheel for gems and rare rewards
🏆 Complete achievements and earn gems

🎁 Use codes 100LIKES and 50LIKES for free gems!
Next code at 150LIKES

⭐ PREMIUM PLAYERS get +20% gems and an extra free spin every day!

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for more updates!
👥 Join the group for a FREE reward!
